ux.botpages.archive.title: Archive or delete
ux.botpages.archive.body: Hides {name} and stops its routines. Its chats, memory, routines and files are kept, and you can bring it back from Bots. Its saved app choices are not kept: {name} comes back set to Only chosen apps with no apps.
ux.botpages.archive.done: {name} archived. You can bring it back from Bots.
ux.botpages.delete.body: Removes {name}, its chats, memory and routines for good. A backup is the only way back.
